BarrierOption.description:
Barrier option with a total trade rebate and explicit contractual monitoring.
Continuous monitoring uses closed-form pricing by default. Discrete monitoring
observes only the supplied dates and uses Monte Carlo by default.

attributes.description: Attributes for scenario selection and grouping

barrier.description:
Barrier level: the absolute underlying price that triggers the
knock-in/out, in the same quote units as `strike`.

currency.description: Currency of the strike, premium and present value.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve ID for present value calculations

expiry_fixing.description:
Terminal underlying fixing observed at expiry, in the same quote units
as `strike`.

Required when valuing after expiry so the realized intrinsic value is
invariant to later market spot updates. At expiry, the current market
spot is used when this field is absent.

monitoring.description:
Contractual monitoring: continuous or an explicit, strictly increasing
set of observation dates no later than expiry. Discrete pricing does not
interpolate hits between those dates.

observed_barrier_breached.description:
Observed barrier state for expired options.

Historical barrier monitoring must be supplied explicitly for expired
options because terminal spot alone does not reveal whether the barrier
was breached intralife and then reversed.

quantity.description: Number of underlying units the option is written on; PV and Greeks scale linearly with it.

rebate_timing.description:
Payment timing of the rebate. Required exactly when `rebate` is set.

For a knock-out, `at_hit` pays the rebate at the first qualifying hit
and `at_expiry` defers it to expiry. A knock-in (no-hit) rebate is
only determined at expiry, so it must be `at_expiry`; `at_hit` is
rejected. The analytical pricer values at-hit knock-out rebates via
the discounted first-passage closed form; Monte Carlo applies at-hit
timing via `with_rebate_at_hit`.

BarrierType.description:
Four-state barrier option classification.

In/out describes whether a qualifying hit deactivates or activates the
option. It does not describe payment entitlement or the option's current
state.

oneOf.description: Up-and-out: knocked out by an eligible observation at or above the barrier.
Up-and-in: activated by an eligible observation at or above the barrier.
Down-and-out: knocked out by an eligible observation at or below the barrier.
Down-and-in: activated by an eligible observation at or below the barrier.

InstrumentSchema.description: Canonical schema marker for persisted instrument envelopes.

oneOf.description: Monitor continuously through the contractual monitoring interval.
Monitor only at the stated contractual observation dates.

observation_dates.description: Strictly increasing dates on which the barrier level is observed.

OptionType.description: Option payoff direction used by analytical and numerical model engines.

PayoutTiming.description:
When an otherwise entitled barrier-conditional cash amount is paid.

The timing schedules a payment; it does not grant entitlement, choose the
amount or currency, or set a settlement lag, curve or clock. Each product
validates which timings its payoff supports. For example, a no-hit
(knock-in) rebate is only determined at expiry, so products reject
`AtHit` for it rather than silently replacing the selection.

oneOf.description: Paid at the first qualifying recognized hit.
Paid at the product's specified expiry.
